name: Sesame Crusted Cod with Avocado & Green Bean-Bell Pepper Sauté
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim green beans, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place eggs and cornstarch in another medium bowl; beat with a whisk or fork until smooth.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place sesame seeds on another plate. Dip cod in the egg mixture, then dredge in the sesame seeds, pressing gently to adhere; return to the plate.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips; add to the bowl with the green beans.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide cod and veggies between plates or bowls; top cod with avocado. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
